tasks.title: Setup Checklist || Deliver belt packs ~ 90 minutes before tip-off

items.label: Verify and take a picture of the game and referee names loaded on the PTS screen(front table)

Using the picture, gather the corresponding referee packs from the bin in the IT office and replace the old batteries still in the packs. ALWAYS include an extra pack with fresh batteries in case of emergencies.
Record referee names on the back of the corresponding belt packs using tape and a silver sharpie
Verify that there are two clips connected for each pack
Power on all belt packs
Confirm battery levels are fully green by going down to the PTS and checking on screen 2 hours before the game starts
Double check that power is on and deliver to referees/officers outside officials room in D-VOM 90 minutes before the game. The extra pack stays at the D-VOM table
**WARNING** Fines are accrued if belt packs are delivered late.
Equipment should be set up on the second table from right ONLY (when facing the court).
Place switch on top of table and connect to power.
Connect blue Ethernet cable labeled 'trunk'(stored under bleacher) to the trunk switch port 16.
Place laptops on table in this specific order from left to right: Secondary, Primary and PR
Using cables that have been ziptied (2 white cables and one green) connect to switch ports 1, 2, and 3
From switch port 1, direct connect to the Secondary Laptop
From switch port 2, direct connect to the Primary Laptop
From switch port 3, direct connect to the PR Laptop
Place UPS on table next to switch but behind the primary laptop
Plug all chargers into UPS and into the laptops
Connect black cable labled 'clock' to the usb port on the back of the Primary Laptop ethernet via USB to ethernet adapter
Place replay monitor on table to the left of the switch

Open the latch using the red button on the back of monitor, connect the black power cable and bank to the power strips behind the monitor, connect the other end to the replay monitor and power on the replay monitor.
Connect keyboard, mouse, replay controller and ethernet cable (direct connect to port 4) to the back of the replay monitor.
Double-check peripheral function to make sure they works
Place RTS in front of the switch, to the right of the keyboard, and direct connect to port 5 using blue ethernet cable labeled 'RTS'
Connect phones using two 3ft green ethernet cables labled 'phones' to ports 10 and 11 on switch
Connect phone light to port 18 using a 3ft white ethernet cable labeled 'phone light'
Dial both extensions to verify phones and phone light are working
Provide 3 bricks (stats sets up) and 2 power cords to the furthest left table. One will be set aside as a spare brick.
Run 1 black 25ft ethernet cord labeled 'bricks' to far end of tables to the left.
Run 1 blue 25ft ethernet cord labeled 'bricks' to far end of tables to the left.
Run 1 blue 15ft ethernet cord labeled to be placed directly to the left of the replay monitor.
Note: Ports 12-17 are for internet pointing out and ports 19-20 are for home radio setup
Connect the blue extension cord under bleacher labled 'Printer-EXT to the power strip beneath the bleacher'
Connect USB printer Extension cable to the USB port on the back of the PR laptop, run it underneath the chair and connect to printer
Run the blue extension cord underneath the chair
Gaff both cables down to floor and make sure that they are not able to be snagged or tripped over
Provide a box of toner (850) and a pack of paper and place it on the counter behind the printer
On the PR laptop, go to settings and print a test page to verify printer is working properly
Test all biscuit connection for internet connectivity using the fluke or tester laptop(they need to be able to access the web)
Leave 4 biscuits to the right of table in section 108 free for social media ethernet cables (they will provide their own cables).
Place request forms for the 6ft Pink Ethernet cables in all of the corresponding sections
Call 201-974-6917 for system test
Test game clock, stats radio and headset
label chanel for stats radio
Print sample stats page
Complete NBA Form linked on physical instructions

Verify Netgear switch is powered on and connected to EVENT VLAN

Verify phone is powered on and has a dial tone
Verify stats phone is connected to NBA VLAN
Verify trucks have internet and stats feeds
Verify power and network connectivity
Setup Zoom Carts in specified location.
Hang NBA backdrop
